children: Ocean Capital Acquisition announced its sponsor's issued and outstanding equity interests were transferred to Chi-Ping Cindy Lee.
Poseidon Ocean Corporation and four individuals transferred a total of 3,833,333 Sponsor ordinary shares to Chi-Ping Cindy Lee.
The transfers represent 100% of the issued and outstanding equity interests in the Sponsor, now wholly owned by Chi-Ping Cindy Lee.
The Sponsor remains the Company's sponsor and retains the same number of Company securities as before the transfers.
Existing rights and obligations of the Sponsor under IPO-related agreements remain unchanged following the ownership change.
